Codex window title corrected with no UI layout/callback changes
Existing localized codex UI changed only by helper require and two asset-read display hooks

Lua: copy-on-write preserves original tables and all IDs, arrays, numbers and control values

Actual codex UI: postinit/category/list/next/previous callbacks deliver Japanese title and all power-guide pages while preserving IDs and page limits
